reason: Nobody I know has run this, and it isn't live in any restaurant yet, so I'd be the test on my Friday and Saturday rush. R699 a month is a fixed cost I'd have to justify every month, and I don't yet see where it saves me money.
objection: Setting it up and training my staff takes time I don't have, and I've got no proof it holds up when the kitchen is slammed on a Saturday.
would_change_my_mind: A live reference restaurant like mine showing a month of real numbers, with setup and staff training done for me and a pilot I can stop without a penalty.
